visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a man in a black work shirt and a backward cap standing in a workshop. He gestures while talking to the camera. Behind him, rows of power tools like drills and impacts are neatly arranged on a pegboard. (2) A montage of four black-and-white portraits appears, featuring Kiichiro Toyoda, Soichiro Honda, Henry Ford, and Ferdinand Porsche with their names in text. (3) The camera cuts back to the man in the workshop as he continues his explanation, pointing with his fingers for emphasis. (4) A high-gloss close-up of a silver Mercedes-Benz logo mounted on a black car grille is shown. (5) A historical black-and-white portrait of a young girl named Mercédès is displayed, with her name and her father's name (Emil Jellinek) written in Chinese. A faint Mercedes logo is superimposed over the image. (6) The video concludes with a promotional end screen showing the man again, alongside a Ford logo and a vintage car, with a large text overlay prompting viewers to watch the full content.
